import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXN = 10000010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, m, c, d, k, totalCost = 0;
    static int s = 0, t, idx = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN], to = new int[MAXN], nxt = new int[MAXN], cap = new int[MAXN], w = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN], flow = new int[MAXN], pre = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] inq = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int weight) {
        to[++idx] = v; nxt[idx] = head[u]; head[u] = idx; cap[idx] = capacity; w[idx] = weight;
        to[++idx] = u; nxt[idx] = head[v]; head[v] = idx; cap[idx] = 0; w[idx] = -weight;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inq, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        flow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        inq[s] = true;
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll(); inq[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (cap[i] == 0 || dist[to[i]] <= dist[u] + w[i]) continue;
                dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + w[i];
                flow[to[i]] = Math.min(flow[u], cap[i]);
                pre[to[i]] = i;
                if (!inq[to[i]]) {
                    inq[to[i]] = true;
                    q.offer(to[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }

    static void updateFlow() {
        int u = t;
        while (u != s) {
            int i = pre[u];
            cap[i] -= flow[t];
            cap[i ^ 1] += flow[t];
            u = to[i ^ 1];
        }
        totalCost += flow[t] * dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();

        t = (n + k - 1) * n + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(s, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + k; j++) {
                for (int h = 1; h <= k; h++) {
                    int costVal = d * h * 2 - d + c;
                    addEdge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + j * n, 1, costVal);
                    addEdge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + j * n, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n + k; i++) {
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                addEdge(j + (i - 1) * n, j + i * n, INF, c);
            }
            addEdge(1 + (i - 1) * n, 1 + i * n, INF, 0);
        }

        while (spfa()) {
            updateFlow();
        }

        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
